publicBlueprintVisits.api: StructureLibAPI.enableInstrument + synchronous StructureElementVisitedEvent guard during one IConstructable.construct(stack,false)
publicBlueprintVisits.visitCoverageGap: StructureLib unloaded-coordinate traversal can invoke an element without a public visit event; controller callbacks can also write without events
publicBlueprintVisits.coordinateExtentScope: Instrumented loaded-coordinate visits only; not a complete shape survey or full write extent
publicBlueprintVisits.workBudgetPolicy: Dispatch allowance max(65536,reserveVolume*1024), capped at 16777216, plus 5 seconds checked at instrumented events and after return; finite work policy allowing repeated public native hatch checks, not a shape or arbitrary callback bound
publicBlueprintVisits.descriptionScope: Partial public element category keys; probe priority only, never an acceptance rule or proof that an omitted hatch role is absent
publicBlueprintVisits.descriptionMergePolicy: Public descriptions cached by element identity; union of up to 32 category keys per coordinate, including different elements encountered during nested checks

observedExtent.measurement: actual occupied blocks observed inside the declared reserve after native construction and before port replacements

genericPortProbes.algorithm: public StructureLib role description keys prioritize actual casing candidates; registered hatch placement; public checkStructure(true); actual standard hatch-list membership
genericPortProbes.optionalUndescribedRoles: not probed; unsupported is diagnostic, never proof of absence

publicEnergyTierSelection.policy: Highest actual standard public tier 01..04 that forms and reports positive public input voltage; no machine-specific tier assumption

startupPreparation.progression: ordinary FML world ticks; no fast-forward or direct tile tick

publicPowerSupply.policy: Actual standard hatch public voltage times amperage; bounded ordinary buffer receipt

publicRecipeSelection.rule: shortest deterministic simple recipe fitting actual ports; no special slots, metadata, NBT-sensitive or fake recipes

infiniteRecipe.sourceSemantics: public GT debug phantom, logical exposure Integer.MAX_VALUE; physical finite conservation is inapplicable
infiniteRecipe.batchModePolicy: Ordinary public unbatched production; parallelism and overclocking remain native
infiniteRecipe.timingEndpoint: main agent receives and reports quantified ongoing synthesis information; recovery/stop/stability lifetime separately measured

debugReceiverCapacity.policy: Actual bounded public receivers; validate whole incoming batch before extraction; no voiding or virtual receiver
